# awscc_sagemaker_human_task_ui (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::HumanTaskUi



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `human_task_ui_name` (String) The name of the human task user interface.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs that contain metadata to help you categorize and organize a human review workflow user interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `ui_template` (Attributes) The Liquid template for the worker user interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ui_template))

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) The timestamp when the human task user interface was created.
- `human_task_ui_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the human task user interface.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.


<a id="nestedatt--ui_template"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ui_template`

Optional:

- `content` (String) The content of the Liquid template for the worker user interface.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_human_task_ui.example
  identity = {
    human_task_ui_arn = "human_task_ui_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `human_task_ui_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the human task user interface

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_human_task_ui.example
  id = "human_task_ui_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
